allstreet-apparel.generationPrompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Create a portrait 3:4 editorial streetwear concept photograph, NOT a finished magazine cover. Two clearly adult fashion models, a man and a woman, wearing unbranded relaxed streetwear: oversized neutral jacket, plain T-shirt, wide-leg trousers and simple sneakers. Casual confident standing poses outside against a plain light architectural concrete wall. Show both models from head to shoes, occupying middle and lower frame, leaving some quiet space at top. Refined independent fashion editorial, natural daylight, realistic anatomy and fabric, restrained charcoal, gray and off-white palette. No lettering, logos, monograms, watermarks or accessories with visible branding. This will be shown faintly behind an off-white website magazine cover with a gold AS monogram layered in HTML; keep the photo itself normally exposed with real detail, not pre-faded. Fictional people and conceptual clothing, not a depiction of any existing brand collection.
